limits: Agent judgments from supplied Oracle text and metadata, not a human study or owner acceptance; no claim of expert MTG adjudication.
Pool contains only supplied first-five candidates; these judgments do not establish exhaustive recall or missing relevant cards.
Rules queries are desired effect fragments. Explicit conditional or modal execution counts as direct relevance. Additional costs, discards, or collateral effects do not negate the requested effect.
Explicit all-creatures requests require coverage of all creatures. Restricted creature subsets fail that constraint; all-other-creatures destruction receives partial credit.
Attack-prevention fragment has no explicit opponent or universal constraint; subgroup attack prohibitions qualify. Self-only attack restrictions receive partial credit.
Narrower spell target types receive zero; mana-value, name, snow, or spell-target restrictions receive partial credit as restricted applications. This distinction is judgment-sensitive.
Cheap is interpreted as mana value two or less for these supplied candidates; no monetary affordability data was provided.

Special-format stickers, humorous cards, digital cards, and split/transformed cards are judged on supplied text without legality restrictions. Their practical usability requires separate format context.
Protection against some damage wipes for the creature itself and conditional combat damage prevention receive partial credit; neither is treated as broad protection or actual attack prevention.

q38 contains double strike and doubled power instead of duplicated triggered abilities; Seventh Stage of Magic Design explicitly copies triggered abilities. Candidate IDs: 22fef646-acc1-4dda-81b0-0ef6dc04a83f.
q39 has no candidate land that actually produces two colorless mana. Several entries confuse color with colorless or mana production with mana cost.
q40 lacks direct team protection against board wipes; several candidates protect only themselves, protect the player, or grant unrelated keywords.
German draw-three query q33 has five direct answers, while German attack-prevention query q36 has none. This describes the pool, not an engine comparison.
